name: seo-runner
description: Office-machine runner for AI-OPS SEO Growth (path B): runs the Ubersuggest MCP client (OAuth sign-in once, headless thereafter), pulls a small batch of pending keywords, and PUSHES the raw results to the app at /api/seo/ingest. Free-tier safe: drips SEO_BATCH keywords/run and stops on a quota/limit response so the app's watcher can alert. Never fabricates data.
